value:
Commercial inbound interest since 2026-05-06: organic GitHub inquiries from strangers + informal employer interest. Employer's "let us take it over and make it private" framing REJECTED — would kill the consulting path and OSS; big-corp wheels turn slowly, no time pressure.

LEGAL (clean): MIT, sole copyright Kory Hoopes, full dual-licensing rights; employment IP clause protects personal-time/personal-device work; no CLA complications.

SHAPE: OSS + consulting via SeaBear Studios. OSS stays fully featured (no crippleware); commercial value is methodology/expertise transfer (seed-density, dogfooding loop, governance), not feature gates. Chosen for sustainable solo income over venture scale — product surface too small for an open-core wedge.

SEQUENCING: 1) v1.0.0 launch ✓ 2026-05-07. 2) NEXT: engage 1-2 GitHub inbounds as first paying customers (smaller orgs move faster, lower-stakes debugging of the offering). 3) Build case studies. 4) Only then approach employer, with references and a procurement story. Norm-set early on free-support drift: "happy to help via OSS channels; if business-critical, my firm can scope it."

WATCH: revenue bounded by hours; bus factor of one (productize methodology if scaling); paid asks louder than telemetry — keep triage discipline; if 2+ customers want self-serve product more than consulting, reconsider the shape. Pricing/contracts/deal structure deferred to accountant + lawyer — don't substitute for them.
